_comment: ArchiMate 3.2. Edit archimate.md to change the agent's guidance. Relation styles are draw.io edge styles.
name: archimate
title: ArchiMate 3.2
description: Enterprise architecture models: business, application, technology, motivation, strategy and implementation layers.

composition.description: Structural. Source (the whole) is composed of target (the part); the part cannot exist without the whole. Diamond drawn at the source.

aggregation.description: Structural. Source (the whole) groups target (the part); the part may belong to several wholes. Hollow diamond at the source.

assignment.description: Structural. Allocation of responsibility/execution: active structure -> behaviour (actor/role -> process, component -> function, node -> system software), or actor -> role.

realization.description: Structural. Source realizes target: e.g. application component -> application service, artifact -> application component, process -> service, core element -> requirement/goal.

serving.description: Dependency. Source provides its functionality to target: service -> process/component/actor, interface -> role, lower layer -> upper layer.

access.description: Dependency. Behaviour/active element (source) accesses a passive object (target), direction unspecified.

access_read.description: Dependency. Source reads target passive object (arrowhead points to the reader, i.e. the source).

access_write.description: Dependency. Source writes target passive object (arrowhead at the object).

access_readwrite.description: Dependency. Source reads and writes target passive object.

influence.description: Dependency. Source positively/negatively influences target, mainly between motivation elements. Put '+', '-', '++' or '--' in the label when known.

triggering.description: Dynamic. Temporal or causal precedence between behaviour elements/events (source happens before target).

flow.description: Dynamic. Transfer (of information, goods, value) from source behaviour to target behaviour. Label with what flows.

specialization.description: Other. Source is a specialization (kind) of target; both must be the same element type.

association.description: Other. Undirected relationship not covered by another type; use sparingly.
